provenance.retrieval_method: public-web pilot searches; direct source URLs retained in CAL-PILOT-SOURCES-001

terminology_rule: Same model means the same named Codex model/version. Independence is never asserted without a qualifier; fresh contexts and repeated samples are procedural separation, not separate training, ownership, incentives, or trust roots.

mechanism_classes.label: same-model self-review or self-refinement
mechanism_classes.gate_relevance: candidate procedural control; requires comparative detection evidence

mechanism_classes.label: judge calibration, bias, instability, and panel disagreement
mechanism_classes.gate_relevance: tests whether model verdicts need calibration, repetition, randomized ordering, or escalation

mechanism_classes.label: executable specification and fault-oriented validation
mechanism_classes.gate_relevance: binds a verdict to observable behavior rather than model preference

mechanism_classes.label: provenance, integrity, and version binding
mechanism_classes.gate_relevance: binds artifacts, criteria, tools, and records; does not by itself establish semantic correctness

mechanism_classes.label: prompt-injection and untrusted-artifact controls
mechanism_classes.gate_relevance: separates reviewed artifact data from gate instructions and limits action authority

mechanism_classes.label: risk-tiered human authority and escalation
mechanism_classes.gate_relevance: assigns authority for unresolved, high-impact, or untestable criteria

mechanism_classes.label: criteria and evaluation-dataset formalization
mechanism_classes.gate_relevance: makes gate criteria versioned and testable

mechanism_classes.label: evidence-bound verdict and failure reporting
mechanism_classes.gate_relevance: requires verdicts, uncertainty, and missing evidence to be observable and auditable

boundaries.interpretive_limit: This is a terminology and candidate map only. Source snippets are not treated as verified findings.
